title: Ardonia
description: A vanilla RPG server based on Songs of War animation
body:
![A screenshot of Sendaria - one of the ardoni provinces](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b329a3d1c2e758bb9eda10683c75707a5e26d27.jpeg)

### About
Ardonia is a Minecraft: Java Edition RPG server based on [**Songs of War**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yCNUP2NAt-A) animation by Squared Media. It features an **original map** from the series, **working Songs** (powerful artifacts which grant their users unique abilities), lots of **custom weapons**, a comprehensive **original characters system** and much more - all **without any mods**!

---

### Key features
- Working Songs with high quality VFX and SFX
- Custom weapons and items with 3D models
- Unique per-race abilities
- An advanced OC Manager
- Original Songs of War map
- Lots of custom gameplay mechanics
- 100% original concepts, textures and code

---

### Current status
The server was originally created in 2020 and has since undergone major changes. Currently it's being **completely rewritten** for best possible gameplay experience on modern versions.
